programs.description: Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.
A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.
Maheshwar struggles to raise Malu, his 5-year-old daughter, who holds him responsible for her mother's passing. Ganga attempts to mend the rift between them.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Hardworking villager Jambulingam decides to fight against the oppressive landlord who exploits the local people. He stands against the barbarities and atrocities inflicted upon the villagers.
Mohanakrishnan is a fashion photographer and his brother's ghost haunts him. He had died after being bitten by a snake, leaving behind a young wife.
After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.
Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.
Viswan, a smuggler, keeps his identity hidden from the new commissioner in town, Chandradas. However, once Chandradas uncovers Viswan's true identity, he starts to track him down.
Two friends, Prince and Sadasivan, agree to kidnap a girl for their friend, Pavithran. However, they find themselves in trouble when they abduct the wrong woman who then refuses to leave their house.
Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.
Indira's life turns upside down after she gets a life sentence for murdering Avarachan, a landlord, who killed a young tribal woman after raping her.

Three out of four brothers of a Malayali household are happily married while the fourth brother is engaged. When the beautiful Yamuna Rani becomes their new neighbour, she poses a threat to the wives.
Madhava Menon, a village chief who is highly respected for his integrity, faces trouble when a rival clan wreaks havoc in his village. Soon, his son decides to restore order.
Monayi goes to the city to stay with his friend. However, he ends up getting involved in problems which turns chaotic for everyone.
Gopi, a farmer, looks after his younger brother, Dinesh, a college student. Things take a turn when Gopi marries a Muslim girl.
Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.
Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.
Sreenivasan, a simple villager, is passionate about local theatre and hanging out with his friends. His life takes a turn when he applies for a job in the police department.
Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.
Amarnath, a police officer, tries to settle a communal riot that has taken place among the fishermen. However, he faces many challenges as he strives to bring the criminals to justice.
Bhama falls in love with Shankaran, but she is forced to marry another man. However, her life takes a turn when she discovers that her husband is already married.
Documentary filmmaker Aleena delves into the mysterious disappearance of the yesteryear Malayalam actress, Gracy, from the silver screen.
Radha and Krishna are lovers who must face various challenges as they attempt to reunite after a curse separates them for a hundred years.
Babu perfects the art of being a clown and is promised the hand of Kamala, the circus owner's daughter. However, things take a turn when Sudheer Misra arrives in the troupe.
